entries.en: Using the alumina salts you brought him, Gerolt adds the finishing touches to your relic weapon. Even as he declares his work over, however, the man believes that there is still something incomplete about it. In order to shed light upon the mystery, Gerolt suggests that you seek out literature surrounding the hero associated with the relic. Perhaps the trader Rowena back at Revenant's Toll will be able to assist you in this endeavor.

entries.en: It's a priceless heirloom what belonged to the Cant clan, one of the foremost families in Gridania. Thing is, it went missin' some decades ago, along with its owner, none other'n A-Towa-Cant.

entries.fr: Ce bâton est transmis depuis des générations chez les Cant, une des familles les plus anciennes de Gridania. Le seul problème, c'est qu'ça fait un bail que son dernier possesseur a disparu.
entries.ja:
ヤツについては、多少知ってるぜ。
一生のほとンどを、黒衣森で過ごす他の角尊とは違い、
森の外に棲まう精霊を探し求め、各地を放浪したンだよな。

entries.en: The bloke was known for bein' a bit of an eccentric among his kind. Whereas most Padjals live out their days in the Black Shroud, he went off in search of elementals in distant lands.
entries.fr: La plupart des Padjals quitteront jamais la forêt de Sombrelinceul, mais A-Towa-Cant a passé sa vie à rechercher des âmes égarées à travers tout l'pays.
entries.ja:
その道中、癒しの技で人々を助ける善行も重ねたンだが、
バイルブランド島のオ・ゴモロ山に向かったのを最後に
行方知れずになっちまった……。

entries.fr: Avec son précieux , il a généreusement aidé toutes les personnes dans le besoin qu'il a pu rencontrer. Mais son périple a pris fin à O'Ghomoro pour des raisons inconnues.
entries.ja:
結局、カント家はア・トワを最後に途絶えちまってな。
